summary: Bus-route through road; bushy kerb has no parking and no room off the lane.
reasons: Bus route, no cars parked on bush kerb
Bush and trees right at the kerb

best_section.where: Stanley Terrace south kerb, under the bush before the Taringa junction

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the south side with no dwellings; houses across the road are 14-20 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide road with bus route; the bush edge leaves no clear pull-off beyond the lane.
drivers.traffic: Collector road with buses and steady traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the north kerb and in the driveway apron at about 55-75 m, but not under the bush.

flags: Steep end: mean grade 3.8%, max 11.4% overall
Dwellings 9-14 m at several points along the stretch
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the south kerb, shading from the south and overhead.
cannot_judge: Width of verge under the canopy
